name: agent-comms
description: Communication skills for short-form video and social publishing: attention-architect writes the script and names the mechanism behind every beat, video-director carries the production decisions and the traps that have already cost time, audience-audit measures what the audience actually does, content-strategist decides what to publish next and where. The idea and structure-carousel packs and a studio kit (validators, a guide-mode prompt renderer and answer parser) let a product run the chain as steps with fixed deliverables.
